name: ldg-build-the-role-play
description: Builds a role-play kit with learning points, role cards, a good and a poor model of the same conversation, observer notes that go only to the learner, debrief questions and each learner's own goal for the job. Use for "run ldg-build-the-role-play", "role play training", "role play scenarios", "role play exercise", "practise a difficult conversation", "sales role play", "observer notes for role play", "debrief questions after role play", part of The Complete Claude Guide for L&D Pack by 90n.
